questions.explanation: Imparfait marks background or habitual past actions. Passe compose marks completed events.

questions.subject: FRENCH

stimulus.body: A study group revises a sentence with parce que. The tutor asks which clause is the cause and which is the consequence. The group discusses the order. The revision continues.

questions.stem: Which clause is the cause in parce que il pleut, je reste?

options.misconception: treats the connector as a clause

questions.explanation: In parce que il pleut, je reste, il pleut is the cause and je reste is the consequence. Confusing them reverses the relation.
questions.hint: The parce que clause is the cause.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.stem: Stage one: a study group writes a purpose. Stage two: complete with afin que plus subjonctif.

options.text: Je parle afin que il comprend
options.misconception: fails to contract and uses indicative

options.text: Je parle afin qu il comprend
Je parle pour qu il comprenne
options.misconception: uses pour que instead of afin que

options.text: Je parle afin qu il comprenne

questions.explanation: Afin que requires the subjonctif and contracts to afin qu before a vowel. Indicative or pour que is wrong.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: One word that changes what a sentence means
questions.stem: A study group revises a sentence; which word makes it negative?

options.text: Ajouter ne et pas autour du verbe

questions.explanation: Negation requires ne before the verb and pas after. Seulement limits, and jamais or plus without ne fail to negate.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Register marked by tu and vous
questions.learningObjective: Explain register marked by tu and vous
questions.stem: A learner explains how tu and vous mark register in a study group revision.

answer.exemplar: Tu marks informal or singular address, while vous marks formal or plural address, as in tu viens versus vous venez.

questions.explanation: The choice signals social distance and number. Confusing them misreads the relationship.
